author: Life of Boris
description:
🚗🍾 BORISTAN: the first playable demo, and the public playtest is OPEN.

BORISTAN is a Soviet town in 1987 where the roads are bad, vodka is medicine and the Lada starts on the second try. Not realistic. BORISTIC.

▶ Play free: https://lifeofboris.itch.io/boristan
⬇ Download recommended: the Windows, Mac and Linux versions run MUCH smoother than the browser, which is often limited in FPS and load times. The browser version is there for a quick look or on a phone.

⏰ The playtest ends Tuesday 20 October at 20:00 Eastern European time (EEST): 19:00 Central Europe, 18:00 UK, 17:00 UTC, 13:00 New York, 10:00 Los Angeles.

💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/AEHgdjyUyW
🐞 Found a bug? Press F4 in the game right when it happens (fn+F4 on a Mac), then post the screenshot and text file in #playtest-bugs.
💡 Ideas and opinions: #playtest-feedback
📸 Funny moments, co-op meetups, Lada crimes: #comrade-moments

🎮 Controls: mouse and keyboard, an Xbox or PlayStation controller, or touch in the phone browse
title: BORISTAN is PLAYABLE: Lada, Vodka, Co-op | Public Playtest Opens
